scope: In-memory Discord transport and service fixtures only; no credentials, network, database, or actual signatures.

checks.name: Bank command is opt-in; existing commands are unchanged and new options are typed and bounded
No bank runtime means no bank registration or signing; legacy agent panel still works
Loan preview shows exact immutable money, collateral, term, grace and auction terms without signing
Only actual preview owner can confirm; original operation survives click IDs and repeat clicks do not resign
Exact-output swap displays maximum spend and both deadlines before confirmation; incomplete terms fail closed
Borrowers and workers resolve verified guild identity IDs; unknown recipients dispatch nothing
Wrong guild, bot user and failed acknowledgement dispatch no previews or confirmations
Loans, wallet history, credits and work are readable ephemeral replies without confirmation or signing
